task.title: Data Mapping Configuration Builder with Visual Field Mapper
task.description: Build a comprehensive mapping configuration interface that allows users to create, edit, and manage data synchronization mappings between systems. The UI should include: (1) Mapping list view showing all saved mappings with name, source/destination systems, field count, last modified date, and active/inactive status toggle; (2) Visual mapping builder with drag-and-drop or side-by-side panels displaying source system fields on left and destination fields on right; (3) Field mapping configuration with 1-to-1, 1-to-many, and many-to-1 relationship options; (4) Transformation rule builder for each field mapping supporting operations like: text formatting (uppercase, lowercase, trim), date/time conversions, concatenation, split, lookup tables, conditional logic (if-then-else), custom JavaScript expressions, and default values; (5) Data type validation and compatibility warnings when mapping incompatible fields; (6) Field preview showing sample source data and transformed output; (7) Mapping validation that checks for required destination fields, circular dependencies, and invalid transformations; (8) Save/update functionality persisting to localStorage with schema version; (9) Duplicate mapping feature; (10) Delete mapping with confirmation; (11) Import/export mappings as JSON; (12) Search and filter for fields within the mapper; (13) Mapping metadata form for name, description, source/destination system selection, schedule configuration (frequency, time), and batch size settings. Store mappings in localStorage with structure: {id, name, description, sourceSystem, destinationSystem, fieldMappings: [{sourceField, destField, transformations: []}], schedule, batchSize, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt}.
task.rationale: The sync execution engine is complete but has no way for users to create or configure the mappings it executes. This is the most critical missing piece - without mapping configuration, users cannot define WHAT to sync or HOW data should be transformed. This feature directly enables the core value proposition of the system by allowing users to set up their own data synchronization workflows. It's the prerequisite for any actual sync operations and must come before features like scheduling management, error handling improvements, or analytics, since those all depend on having configured mappings to work with.

issues: Incomplete data structure: 'mysql' fields array is truncated mid-property
Missing input validation: form inputs lack sanitization and validation logic
XSS vulnerability: no HTML escaping implemented for dynamic content rendering
Critical XSS vulnerability: Search input and mapping list rendering lack proper sanitization - user input is rendered directly to DOM without escaping, allowing arbitrary script injection
Syntax error on line 119: 'new.toISOString()' is invalid JavaScript and will cause runtime crash - must be 'new Date().toISOString()'
Critical truncation issues: Both renderC() function call and closeAllModal() function are incomplete, indicating corrupted/incomplete code that will fail at runtime
data.feedback: BLOCKING ISSUES - DO NOT DEPLOY: 1) Fix syntax error on line 119 by changing 'new.toISOString()' to 'new Date().toISOString()'. 2) Complete the truncated code sections (renderC() and closeAllModal() calls). 3) Implement XSS protection by escaping all user input before rendering - use textContent instead of innerHTML or implement a sanitization function like: function escape(str) { const div = document.createElement('div'); div.textContent = str; return div.innerHTML; }. 4) Add input validation for search with regex whitelist. 5) Implement keyboard handlers (ESC to close modals). 6) Add ARIA labels for accessibility (aria-label, role attributes). 7) Wrap initialization in try-catch blocks. 8) Validate imported JSON structure before processing. 9) Add pagination for large datasets. 10) Implement click-outside-to-close for modals.

issues: Critical incomplete code: CSS class '.mapp' truncated at end, 'showNotification' function cut off mid-declaration, and '.validation-item' rule missing value - code is not production-ready

Severe accessibility violations: No ARIA labels on interactive elements, missing focus trap in modals, no keyboard navigation for status toggles, and no aria-live regions for dynamic updates - fails WCAG 2.1 Level A requirements
Security vulnerability: Inconsistent XSS protection with 'escapeHtml' only on mapping names but not on system names, field names, or transformation rules - allows potential script injection
data.feedback: CRITICAL FIXES REQUIRED: 1) Complete all truncated code sections - finish the '.mapp' CSS rule, complete 'showNotification' function implementation, and add missing 'margin-bottom' value to '.validation-item'. 2) Add comprehensive accessibility: aria-label='Toggle status' to status buttons, implement focus trap using 'focus-trap' library in modals, add role='status' aria-live='polite' to notification areas, add aria-label to all icon buttons, and support keyboard events (Space/Enter) on toggle buttons. 3) Apply 'escapeHtml()' consistently to ALL user inputs including system names, field names, descriptions, and transformation expressions before rendering. 4) Add modal-overlay click handler to close modal, define loading spinner CSS/HTML, add prefers-reduced-motion media query, and ensure color contrast ratios meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text). Test with screen reader and keyboard-only navigation before deployment.

issues: Critical security vulnerability: No input sanitization for user-entered data (name, description) creates XSS attack vector. User input must be sanitized before rendering to DOM.

Accessibility violations render application unusable for screen readers: Missing aria-labels on icon buttons, modal dialogs lack role='dialog'/aria-modal, draggable items missing aria-grabbed, and no keyboard navigation for drag-and-drop.

Multiple runtime error risks: generateId() and attachGlobalEventListeners() functions called but not defined, missing null checks in migrateMappings could crash on null array, and localStorage quota exceptions not handled with specific QuotaExceededError catch.
data.feedback: MUST FIX IMMEDIATELY: 1) Sanitize all user inputs using DOMPurify or textContent assignment instead of innerHTML. 2) Add missing function definitions for generateId() and attachGlobalEventListeners(). 3) Add comprehensive ARIA attributes: aria-label to all icon buttons, role='dialog' and aria-modal='true' to modals, aria-grabbed to draggable items, and implement keyboard handlers (Space/Enter for selection, Arrow keys for navigation). 4) Wrap migrateMappings array operations in null check. 5) Add try-catch with QuotaExceededError handling in saveMappings(). 6) Complete truncated CSS (justify-content property) and animation keyframe (opacity value). 7) Add input validation with min/max bounds for numeric fields (batchSize, retryCount, timeout). The application has good visual structure but critical security and accessibility gaps prevent production deployment.

data.note: Code provides basic UI structure for MappingListView (table, search, header, empty state, status toggle) and starts MappingBuilderView metadata form, but missing critical features: the visual drag-and-drop field mapper panels, FieldMappingModal with transformation pipeline, validation engine, import/export, connection visualization, and most transformation configuration logic. Only ~30% of specification implemented.

blocking_issues: The code chunk is incomplete - CSS and JavaScript are cut off mid-declaration, making it impossible to properly assess full functionality
No form validation error messages are visible in the UI - users won't know what's wrong when validation fails
Missing keyboard navigation for drag-and-drop functionality - users relying on keyboard cannot create mappings
No ARIA labels or roles on interactive elements like toggles, drag-and-drop areas, and modal dialogs - screen readers cannot properly announce functionality
Toggle switch has no accessible label or keyboard controls (space/enter to toggle) - fails WCAG 2.1 AA
Modal lacks proper focus management - focus trap not visible in code, users can tab outside modal
Draggable field items lack aria-grabbed or role='button' attributes - screen readers won't announce drag capability
Missing keyboard navigation for drag-and-drop alternative - users who cannot use drag-and-drop have no way to create mappings via keyboard alone
No mobile viewport meta tag detected - will break responsive design on mobile devices
Touch targets likely under 44x44px minimum for mobile - buttons and interactive elements need sizing review
Modal interactions not tested for mobile - may have z-index, overflow, or scrolling issues on small screens
No error boundary for localStorage quota exceeded - will fail silently on mobile with limited storage
Field mapping modal likely not scrollable on mobile viewports - long transformation pipelines will be unusable
XSS vulnerabilities: All user inputs rendered with innerHTML without sanitization (transform.config values, sampleValue, error messages)
eval()-like security risk: customJS transformation allows arbitrary code execution in updateTransformationConfig
Drag-and-drop broken: getDragAfterElement logic inserts at wrong position, dragover handler modifies DOM incorrectly
